jobs.title: Materials Characterization Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure, resilient future. With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive, powering a high-technology future. Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence and Integrity.

About the Role

We are seeking a Materials Characterization Engineer to provide technical expertise for materials analysis supporting rare-earth permanent magnet R&D and production. As a hands-on individual contributor, you will lead complex investigations, integrate analytical findings into production and R&D plans, and develop reliable testing capabilities in partnership with the laboratory and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Define characterization plans that answer engineering questions and support process development, quality investigations, and product qualification.
  • Perform and guide characterization within areas of expertise, using optical microscopy, SEM/EDS, ICP-OES, combustion and inert gas fusion analysis, particle sizing, powder rheometry, XRD, or DSC.
  • Lead method development, validation, and transfer into routine testing, defining preparation requirements, performance criteria, and documentation.
  • Establish calibration and quality-control practices; assess uncertainty

jobs.title: Aerodynamics & Analysis Engineering Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.description_text:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (remote)
jobs.description_text: The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.description_text: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

jobs.title: Salesforce Engineer II
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a skilled Enterprise Applications Engineer II to support the design, development, and implementation of scalable, high-performance Salesforce and ecosystem solutions. This role is responsible for building and maintaining applications across Salesforce products, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom applications built on the Salesforce Platform. Leveraging solid expertise in Salesforce development, integration patterns, data modeling, and system design, you will align platform capabilities with business objectives, optimize systems for performance and security, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and senior engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer II - IAM
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Security Engineer II at Aledade, we play a central role in helping secure our enterprise, cloud native environments, and applications. We’re looking for security engineers that understand data and automation are important ingredients to our mission and know how to actively employ these ingredients at scale. Beyond the technical expertise, we value individuals who can partner cross-functionally across various teams, driving impactful outcomes and further securing our digital landscape. We prioritize Security-as-Code and API-first automation over manual administration, building resilient identity pipelines that scale seamlessly with our growth.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Data & Algorithm Engineering
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer I at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our data models and Databricks pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. The Patient Domain Team is responsible for turning complex health care data into well-defined insights about our patients that describes who they are and how they interact with the health care system. We are responsible for telling our partner practices more about who their patients are and how to ensure they receive the care they need. We are also responsible for figuring out how to monitor and observe our models in action to ensure they are driving impact across the company.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- AI Platform
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Software Engineer on Aledade's AI Core Platform team, you will help build and operate the shared infrastructure that enables applications and AI agents across Aledade to securely and reliably access foundation models. You will work on the platform capabilities behind model access, including model gateways, cloud AI services, provider integrations, routing and fallback, usage controls, observability, reliability, and model governance. We’re looking for engineers who think beyond implementing individual features and consider the full lifecycle of production platform systems: architecture, scalability, failure modes, security, observability, operational readiness, cost, and developer experience. You will help evolve the platform as AI adoption grows across Aledade, building reusable and self-service capabilities rather than one-off solutions. You will work closely with engineers, product partners, security, infrastructure teams, and teams building AI applications and agents. Successful engineers in this role are comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic technical decisions, and building secure, maintainable, observable, and resilient systems.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients. The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale. In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description_text: Company Description At Alertus, protecting people from harm is our mission and our passion. As the leader in mass notification, we are committed to providing customizable, scalable, and cost-effective solutions, as we know even a few seconds of warning can help save lives during an emergency. Our employees are integral to the company’s success and impact countless people's lives, safety, and well-being. We aim for a positive, collaborative environment that allows employees to work across departments easily and effectively. Job Description Most design roles focus on a single feature or a specific interface. This is different. As a SeniorUX Designer here, you are a core architect of the "Whole Product" experience and the primary steward of our visual identity within our software. You won’t just be refining pixels; you will be sitting at the intersection of brand strategy, product vision, and technical feasibility. Working directly with our Product Development team, you will ensure our digital solutions are not only functional but are cohesive and easy to use. Your mission is to ensure that as our technical capabilities scale, our user experience remains intuitive, unified, and aligned with our brand. Candidates must be located within driving distance from our Baltimore HQ. The referenced base salary range represents the low and high end of Alertus’ salary range for this position. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Data Center Engineering (Starmind)
jobs.description_text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, DATA CENTER ENGINEERING (STARMIND)

The Data Center Engineering team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross disciplinary team comprised of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.

As an Embedded Software Engineer on our team, you will design, validate, and ship code that reliably and autonomously manages hundreds of thousands of coherently connected GPUs. Your software will span the entire hardware stack from individual firmware ICs up through cluster aggregation networking, ensuring our compute fabric operates at peak efficiency and gracefully handles various fault conditions. To empirically define the limit of physics in our computing hardware, you will also work closely with mechanical, electrical, and optical engineers to develop automated hardware test environments for thermal, radiation, and power testing.
